description: Angular component for managing dashboard customers, including assigning, managing, and unassigning customers via a dialog interface.

classes.name: ManageDashboardCustomersDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular dialog component for managing dashboard customers with assign, manage, and unassign actions.

methods.description: Initializes the form group with assigned customer IDs.

methods.description: Determines if the form control is in an error state.

methods.description: Closes the dialog without saving changes.

methods.description: Submits the form, performing the appropriate dashboard customer management action.

methods.description: Returns an Observable for the dashboard service call based on the action type.
